clue.text: Spring, often underground

definitions.meaning: to spring is to leap, as over a horse in gymnastics
a cellar or burial chamber, frequently below ground level

explanation.definitionFit: A leap with the hands is a vault, and an arched cellar or crypt below a building is also a vault.

clue.text: Government official making conclusive changes

indicators.note: changes says the letters of the word conclusive are rearranged into a new order

explanation.surface: A civil servant whose decisions end every argument.
explanation.definitionFit: A deputy to a diplomatic consul is a minor government appointee abroad.

clue.text: It's not fair for one to use this

definitions.text: It's not fair for one to use this

parts.words: It's not fair for one to use this
parts.note: 'not fair' reads as a complaint of injustice, but means weather that is not fine: rain calls for a shelter carried overhead

explanation.surface: A grumble that some device gives an unfair advantage.
explanation.definitionFit: When the weather is wet rather than fine, a person opens a portable rain shield.

clue.text: What, for example, Cinderella became after twelve

definitions.text: What, for example, Cinderella became after twelve

parts.words: What, for example, Cinderella became after twelve
parts.note: twelve suggests the midnight chime in the fairy tale, but means her twelfth birthday; at thirteen any girl enters her teens

explanation.surface: A question about Cinderella's transformation when the clock struck midnight.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone aged thirteen to nineteen is in their teens, which follows the age of twelve.

clue.text: A request certain to give satisfaction

parts.note: a plea is an earnest appeal or request
sure means certain

explanation.surface: A request so sure of success that granting it is a pleasure.
explanation.definitionFit: Enjoyment and gratification are both senses of satisfaction.

clue.text: Prune — or another fruit, we hear

indicators.note: we hear says the word for the fruit is spoken, giving a different spelling

parts.note: a pear is a fruit other than the prune

explanation.surface: A prune, or perhaps a different fruit, is mentioned in conversation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Prune' looks like the dried plum, which makes 'another fruit' natural; it is really the verb meaning trim.
explanation.definitionFit: To trim or cut back, as a gardener does to a bush, is to pare it.

clue.text: Lowered, like a sailor given the wrong date?

parts.note: AB is an able seaman, a rank of sailor

indicators.note: wrong says the letters of date are put in a mistaken order

explanation.surface: A sailor who turned up on the wrong day and got a reduced welcome.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wrong' turns DATE into ATED, which follows AB.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that has abated has lessened or diminished in force.

clue.text: One who takes great interest in business

definitions.text: One who takes great interest in business

parts.words: One who takes great interest in business
parts.note: reads as a keen entrepreneur, but interest means money charged on loans, taken at an excessive rate

explanation.surface: Praise for someone very engaged in commerce.
explanation.definitionFit: A moneylender charging extortionate rates of interest on loans.

clue.text: The story's only part of the whole picture

indicators.note: only part of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A remark that a story tells only a fragment of the full picture.
explanation.definitionFit: A long heroic narrative poem or tale is a type of story.

clue.text: Suspended uphill transport

parts.note: suspended might mean halted, but here describes cabins hanging from a wire hauled up a slope

explanation.surface: News that a mountain transport service has been stopped.
explanation.definitionFit: A cabin hung from an overhead wire rope that carries passengers up mountains.

clue.text: Secret coteries perhaps

indicators.note: perhaps hints the letters of coteries could form something else when rearranged

explanation.surface: Exclusive cliques are perhaps secretive.
explanation.definitionFit: Knowledge understood only by a small inner circle is obscure or private.

clue.text: Stock market reaction to panic?

parts.note: stock market suggests finance, but stock is livestock, and the reaction of frightened cattle is a headlong rush

explanation.surface: A description of how financial markets respond to fear.
explanation.definitionFit: A sudden panicked rush of a herd of cattle or horses.

clue.text: Make about a thousand to burn

indicators.note: about says the word for make goes around the other piece

parts.note: to create is to make
M is the Roman numeral for a thousand

explanation.surface: An instruction to produce around a thousand items for burning.
explanation.definitionFit: To reduce a dead body to ashes by fire.

clue.text: Arose from having the call-up date wrong

indicators.note: in a down clue up says the word for call is read from bottom to top

parts.note: to name is to call

indicators.note: wrong says the letters of date are jumbled

explanation.surface: Trouble arose because someone's conscription date was mistaken.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns NAME into EMAN, and 'wrong' turns DATE into ATED; 'from having the' only joins the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: To come forth or issue from a source.

clue.text: Wandered, heading middle east instead of west

definitions.text: Wandered, heading middle east instead of west

indicators.note: instead of says one abbreviation takes the place of another in the word

parts.note: W is the compass abbreviation for west

explanation.surface: A traveller drifted off course, going east rather than west.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heading' says the swap is at the front of Wandered. The whole clue defines: to wander is to meander, and a wanderer may well head the wrong way.
explanation.definitionFit: To follow a winding, aimless course, as a river or stroller does.

clue.text: Roads not made for speeding?

parts.note: reads as roads unfit for fast driving, but means unsurfaced tracks laid out for motorcycle speedway racing

explanation.surface: A warning that some roads are unsuitable for fast cars.
explanation.definitionFit: Unmade earth or cinder courses used for motorcycle racing, also rough unpaved lanes.

clue.text: Ring man when sporting practice is required

definitions.text: Ring man when sporting practice is required

parts.words: Ring man when sporting practice is required
parts.note: ring suggests telephoning a man, but means a boxing ring, where a training opponent is needed for practice bouts

explanation.surface: Advice to phone a certain man whenever you need to train.
explanation.definitionFit: A boxer's training opponent who fights practice rounds with him.

clue.text: Response of soldiers in the van of battle

indicators.note: in the van of means at the front of, so the soldiers come first

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a corps of British army soldiers
action is fighting or battle

explanation.surface: How troops at the front line respond in combat.
explanation.definitionFit: A reply or reaction to a stimulus is a response.

clue.text: Slipped quickly indoors and pinched something

definitions.meaning: took in a garment, narrowing it, as at the waist

explanation.definitionFit: To dash briefly inside a place, and also describing a dress taken in at the waist.

clue.text: A tin medal ordered to be plated

indicators.note: ordered says the letters of a tin medal are arranged afresh

explanation.surface: A cheap medal has been commissioned for coating.
explanation.definitionFit: Covered with thin layers or sheets, as with metal or plastic.

clue.text: Defame a large number and get into a row

parts.note: M is a thousand in Roman numerals, a large number
to align is to line up in a row

explanation.surface: Slandering a crowd of people and starting an argument.
explanation.walkthrough: 'row' reads as a quarrel, but means a line.
explanation.definitionFit: To speak ill of someone, slandering them.

clue.text: The game's finished for a small number on the team

indicators.note: in a down clue on means placed above the following piece

parts.note: NO is the abbreviation for number, small because it is shortened
a side is a team

explanation.surface: A coach announcing that a team is down to few players.
explanation.walkthrough: NO SIDE is the referee's call ending a rugby match.
explanation.definitionFit: The rugby referee's call declaring a match over.

clue.text: He's broken out of quarters, a saucy prank!

parts.note: E and S are compass points, two of the four quarters
a caper is a cheeky prank or escapade

explanation.surface: A prisoner bragging that his breakout was a cheeky stunt.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who has got free of captivity is a fugitive.

clue.text: It is inclined to lie low when troubles intervene

indicators.note: intervene says the troubles come between the letters of the word for lie low

parts.note: to hide is to lie low
ills are troubles

explanation.surface: Someone tending to keep out of sight when problems arise.
explanation.definitionFit: A slope is inclined ground, the side of a rise.

clue.text: Retain purchase

definitions.meaning: a grip or foothold, not a buy

explanation.definitionFit: To keep possession is one sense; a firm grip or footing is another.

clue.text: Handy fencing implement

parts.note: fencing suggests building fences, but means swordplay; the weapon is held in the hand

explanation.surface: A useful tool for putting up garden fences.
explanation.definitionFit: A sword with a stiff blade used in sport duelling.

clue.text: Sort of table used by chemists from time to time

definitions.text: Sort of table used by chemists

explanation.definitionFit: The chart of elements has this name; and occurring at intervals means recurrent.

clue.text: Entertainer, possibly Sudanese

indicators.note: possibly hints that the letters of Sudanese might be reworked

explanation.surface: A performer who may come from Sudan.
explanation.definitionFit: A female ballet dancer, a kind of stage performer.

clue.text: Numbers may be dressed up to them

definitions.text: may be dressed up to them
definitions.meaning: the idiom for being dressed very smartly

explanation.definitionFit: Digits just below ten; and being dressed to perfection uses the phrase 'up to the' with this word.
